_note: A target-of-opportunity request group in the OCS shape (docs/design.md 3.7.1, docs/request_language.md): observation_type RAPID_RESPONSE or TIME_CRITICAL, with robofast's deadline, interrupt policy (next, now-after-readout, now) and priority class in extra_params.too (each optional: the deadline defaults to the last window's end). Write it elsewhere, then rename it into the dispatch plan's too_dropbox, or POST it to the request API's /api/requestgroups.
